schema.text: Do you use the car to travel with small children and their things (pushchair, bags)?

ar.#Do you use the car to travel with small: هل تستخدم السيارة من أجل التنقل مع أطفال صغار وأغراضهم (عربة أطفال وحقائب)؟

de.#Do you use the car to travel with small: Nutzen Sie das Auto, um mit kleinen Kindern und ihren Sachen (Kinderwagen, Taschen) unterwegs zu sein?

en.#Do you use the car to travel with small: Do you use the car to travel with small children and their things (pushchair, bags)?

fa.#Do you use the car to travel with small: آیا از خودرو استفاده می‌کنید تا با کودکان کوچک و وسایلشان (کالسکه، کیف) سفر کنید؟

fr.#Do you use the car to travel with small: Utilisez-vous la voiture pour voyager avec de jeunes enfants et leurs affaires (poussette, sacs) ?

hu.#Do you use the car to travel with small: Használja az autót kisgyerekekkel és a holmijukkal (babakocsi, táskák) való utazásra?

it.#Do you use the car to travel with small: Usi l’auto per spostarti con bambini piccoli e le loro cose (passeggino, borse)?

tr.#Do you use the car to travel with small: Küçük çocuklarla ve eşyalarıyla (bebek arabası, çantalar) yolculuk etmek için arabayı kullanıyor musunuz?
